name: send-stability-probe
objective: Diagnostic (not a gate): does #send_but move while an extraction read runs after a real reply?

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; rt.setExtractionSettings({ cadence: 1, stabilityLag: 0 }); delete globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugExtractionResponse; return true;

send_generate.text: I get close to the job board and read the postings.

steps.eval: const samples = []; const started = Date.now(); while (Date.now() - started < 25000) { const box = document.querySelector('#send_but')?.getBoundingClientRect(); const hud = document.querySelector('#so-hud'); samples.push({ t: Date.now() - started, x: Math.round(box?.x ?? -1), y: Math.round(box?.y ?? -1), w: Math.round(box?.width ?? -1), hudH: Math.round(hud?.getBoundingClientRect().height ?? -1), chip: document.querySelector('#so-hud-pipeline')?.textContent ?? null, generating: document.body.dataset.generating ?? null }); await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 100)); } const keys = new Set(samples.map((s) => `${s.x},${s.y},${s.w},${s.hudH}`)); const changes = samples.filter((s, i) => i && `${s.x},${s.y},${s.w},${s.hudH}` !== `${samples[i-1].x},${samples[i-1].y},${samples[i-1].w},${samples[i-1].hudH}`); return { distinct: keys.size, changes: changes.length, first: samples[0], sample: changes.slice(0, 12), chips: [...new Set(samples.map((s) => s.chip))] };
